summary: Phase 1-6 backend end-to-end regression — 18/18 pytest cases pass against live REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 7 retrofit phases validated: fail-fast health, subdomain custom_domain roundtrip + stale-tenant self-heal, S3 presign 401/503, Legal CRUD full cycle (v1→v2 demote, invalid kind 400, employee 403, public 404 with code), reviewer bypass (login without slug, cannot self-delete, 403 with 'reviewer'), soft-delete outstanding_balance 409 guard + reset→200 + session revoked→401, logout-all (200 → me 401 revoked), push register/dedupe/bad-platform/unauth/unregister, push/status shape + shard_capacity=15 + shard_configured=false, push/test disabled='not configured', super shards + tenant 403, iOS viewport-fit=cover in index.html, all logins (super/TA/emp/customer), phone_role_conflict 409 (not 500). No regressions.

minor.issue: Endpoint requires a JSON body (PushTestIn) even though all fields have defaults; calling with no body returns 422. Callers must send `{}`. Consider `payload: PushTestIn = Body(default_factory=PushTestIn)` to accept an empty request.

action_items: (OPTIONAL/LOW) Make POST /api/admin/push/test body optional (currently 422 if no JSON body sent). Not blocking — Admin UI presumably sends a body.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2827 lines — earlier code-review comment about splitting routers still stands (uploads/legal/push/tenant into sub-routers).

PATCH /api/tenant/users/{id} requires a FULL UserIn payload (phone+name+role), which forces callers to fetch-then-PATCH. Consider a true PATCH (exclude_unset) so a partial `{outstanding_amount: 0}` PATCH works without needing to re-send required fields — reduces race conditions on concurrent edits.

reviewer bypass endpoint returns detail plain-string 'reviewer'; other soft-delete errors return dict {code: ...}. Consider unifying to {code: 'reviewer_no_self_delete'} for programmatic checks in the frontend.
